titleAr: الإيقاف التلقائي لما العميل يكتب وقف

ar: العميل كتب STOP ايه اللي بيحصل؟
en: What happens when a customer sends STOP?

steps: STOP, STOP ALL, UNSUBSCRIBE, CANCEL, OPTOUT, إلغاء، وقف، توقف، ايقاف، بطل (whole-message match) or Stop buttons
edgeCases: "please cancel my order" is NOT an opt-out
A bare "Cancel" button is not an opt-out
Opt-out recorded at the Store too
Shared number: STOP opts out of every store that wrote to them when ambiguous
gaps: No merchant control to see/edit opt-out wording or add keywords (brand pack only)
